queries.purpose: Find checkout latency spikes above 750 ms.
queries.query: search index=main source="splunk-incident-lab:checkout" | spath | search service=checkout-api endpoint="/checkout" latency_ms>750 | table _time trace_id status latency_ms message

queries.purpose: Find checkout HTTP errors during the incident window.
queries.query: search index=main source="splunk-incident-lab:checkout" | spath | search service=checkout-api endpoint="/checkout" status>=500 | stats count by status message
